waivers_applied.reason: ComfyUI core versioning behavior is defined by the canonical maintainer surfaces: Comfy-Org repositories, GitHub release data, and docs.comfy.org. Independent third-party sources can discuss usage but are not primary sources for platform version semantics.
compensating_controls: Sources span multiple official artifact types: README, release metadata, CLI documentation, and docs.comfy.org pages.
GitHub API release data provides structured version history directly from the maintainer.
docs.comfy.org is the official documentation surface for workflow, custom node, and interface behavior.
Accepted claims still require span-grounded excerpts and promoted review decisions.
